verdict.rationale: Severing and purging connections is a fair question for an open-finance aggregator, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only data retrieval, refresh, webhooks, onboarding and testing. Nothing in it covers deleting a customer or connected account, stopping collection, or purging held data.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can sever and clean up — a documented way to delete a connection or user and have the platform stop collecting and purge held data
